BELMONT SHORE PARKING AND BUSINESS
  IMPROVEMENT AREA ADVISORY AGENDA

Karen Blair, Vice Chair  Aaron Tofani, Commissioner

  SPECIAL MEETING

CALL TO ORDER

ANNOUNCEMENTS

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-52222  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Belmont Shore Parking and
  Business Improvement Area meeting of Thursday, January 18, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-52224  Recommendation to receive and file a financial report for the period ending January
  31, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-52225  Recommendation to receive and file the Long Beach Transit Employee Bus Pass
  Program Status for January 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-52226  Recommendation to approve an annual cost not to exceed $250,000 for as-needed
  private security services and enter into a contract with CSI Patrol until September
  30, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  24-52227  Recommendation to discuss alley lights in the Belmont Shore Parking and
  Business Improvement Area.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  24-52228  Recommendation to approve a proposal from Conservation Crops for median plant
  replacement, at a cost of $3,400.
